description:
Iñaki Godoy, Emily Rudd, Mackenyu, Jacob Romero, and Taz Skylar (aka the cast of One Piece), step up to the Unlisted board, where every question must either be answered publicly or locked away in the private box. 

From anime hot takes and strange YouTube rabbit holes to behind the scenes moments from set, the group decides what they’re willing to share. Along the way, they reveal favorite characters, cast traditions, and a few secrets from filming… but which answers will they make public?
